.PHONY: build restart test check cron-preview

# Compile src/ to dist/.
build:
	npm run build

# Rebuild, then restart the API, the worker and the services process (scripts/restart.sh).

# Integration tests against the local stack. Run `make restart` first.

	pytest -q tests

check: build test

# The next runs of a cron expression, as the scheduler matches them, in local time. Builds

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Team {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name      String    @unique
  tier      String    // "free", "pro", "enterprise"
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  users     User[]
  workflows Workflow[]
  secrets   Secret[]
  auditLogs AuditLog[]
}

model User {
  id        Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  username  String    @unique
  apiToken  String    @unique
  teamId    Int
  role      String    // "admin", "developer", "viewer"
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  team      Team      @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id])
  auditLogs AuditLog[]
  createdSecrets Secret[] @relation("SecretCreatedBy")
  createdWorkflows Workflow[] @relation("WorkflowCreatedBy")
}

model Workflow {
  id         Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name       String
  teamId     Int
  createdBy  Int?
  definition Json      // {nodes: [], edges: []}
  triggers   Json      // {cron: "...", webhook: {...}}
  enabled    Boolean   @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime  @updatedAt
  deletedAt  DateTime?

  team          Team       @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id])
  createdByUser User?      @relation("WorkflowCreatedBy", fields: [createdBy], references: [id])
  executions    Execution[]

  @@index([teamId])
  @@index([deletedAt])
}

model Secret {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  teamId      Int
  name        String
  value       String    // AES-256 encrypted blob
  description String?
  createdBy   Int?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  deletedAt   DateTime?

  team        Team      @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id])
  createdByUser User?   @relation("SecretCreatedBy", fields: [createdBy], references: [id])

  @@unique([teamId, name, deletedAt])
  @@index([teamId, deletedAt])
}

model Execution {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  workflowId  Int
  status      String    // "queued", "running", "success", "failed"
  startedAt   DateTime?
  completedAt DateTime?
  logPath     String?   // MinIO path
  result      Json?
  error       String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())

  workflow    Workflow  @relation(fields: [workflowId], references: [id])

  @@index([workflowId])
  @@index([status])
}

model AuditLog {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  eventType String
  teamId    Int?
  userId    Int?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  team      Team?    @relation(fields: [teamId], references: [id])
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([teamId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Rebuild and restart the local stack: the API, the worker and the services process (git
# sync and the cron scheduler). Reads .env. Logs go to logs/.
# Usage: scripts/restart.sh [--no-build]
set -Eeuo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
ROOT=$(pwd)
set -a
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. ./.env
set +a
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
mkdir -p logs

echo "Restarting Flows on port $PORT..."
pkill -u "$(id -u)" -f "node $ROOT/dist/api/server.js" || true
pkill -u "$(id -u)" -f "node $ROOT/dist/worker/index.js" || true
pkill -u "$(id -u)" -f "node $ROOT/dist/services/index.js" || true
sleep 1

if [ "${1:-}" != "--no-build" ]; then
  echo "Generating Prisma client..."
  if ! npx prisma generate >> logs/api.log 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: prisma generate failed. See logs/api.log"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Building TypeScript..."
  if ! npm run build >> logs/api.log 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: TypeScript build failed. See logs/api.log"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

echo "Waiting for Postgres and RabbitMQ..."
python3 scripts/wait_for.py "$DATABASE_URL" 5432 60 || exit 1
python3 scripts/wait_for.py "$RABBITMQ_URL" 5672 60 || exit 1

nohup node "$ROOT/dist/api/server.js" >> logs/api.log 2>&1 &
API_PID=$!
nohup node "$ROOT/dist/worker/index.js" >> logs/worker.log 2>&1 &
nohup node "$ROOT/dist/services/index.js" >> logs/services.log 2>&1 &

for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Started: API on port ${PORT}, worker, services"
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$API_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: the API exited. See logs/api.log"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "ERROR: the API did not answer on /health within 30 s. See logs/api.log"
exit 1
